Empty stand-ins for the Agent SDK's 8 `@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-<platform>` packages, linked as npm workspaces (root `package.json` `workspaces`). The SDK always receives the user's installed `claude`, so its bundled binaries are unused; T3 drops them the same way (`pnpm-workspace.yaml:281-289`). Each version must equal the SDK's pinned optional version (`tests/claude-binary-stub.test.ts`).
